gen.title: Bubble sort complexity and improvement checks

cards.stem: What complexity is stated for arbitrary data?
cards.quote: Complexity is O(n^2) for arbitrary data
cards.hint: Think about the worst case for unsorted input.

cards.stem: What does the complexity approach when the list is nearly in order at the beginning?
cards.quote: approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.
cards.hint: Consider the best case for an almost sorted list.

cards.stem: What improvement is suggested because at least one item reaches its final place each pass?
options: decrement the last position checked on each pass
increment the start position each pass
restart from the beginning each time
cards.quote: Since at least one item is moved into its final place for each pass, an improvement is to decrement the last position checked on each pass.
cards.hint: Think about shortening the range that still needs checking.

cards.stem: How does the definition describe ordering adjacent items?
cards.quote: Sort by comparing each adjacent pair of items in a list in turn, swapping the items if necessary
cards.hint: Focus on what happens to each adjacent pair.

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 4 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation, with any numbers matching as whole signed numbers (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation, with no two options spelling the same number (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote as that whole signed number (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
quiz-cards-v1: no weakening — every one of the 2 changed field(s) sits under the affected paths recomputed from revision 1, item counts and ids are stable, and no tolerance increased
